title: oxml-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server exposing oxml's XML toolchain to AI agents: xml_query runs XPath 1.0 over a document, xml_inspect reports its structure (root, namespaces, element counts, depth), xml_check tests well-formedness with a located reason, and xml_validate validates against an XSD schema. Pure Rust, no unsafe code, no network, no configuration; one static binary over JSON-RPC 2.0 on stdio. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Zed and Continue.dev.
